title: Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole
subtitle: Crispy tater tots baked with eggs, bacon, and melty cheese.
description: Tater tots, sausage, and cheese under baked eggs — tater tot hot dish meets breakfast casserole. Crowd-pleaser every time.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Bacon. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 400°F. Grease a deep 9x13 pan. Cook bacon until crisp, drain, and crumble. Keep bacon fat if sautéing optional peppers. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

steps.title: Layer tots and bacon
steps.instruction: Spread half the tater tots in an even layer on the pan bottom. Scatter bacon and half the cheddar over the tots. Add optional sautéed peppers if using. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

steps.title: Add egg mixture
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs, milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth. Pour evenly over the layered tots and bacon so liquid reaches the bottom.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.instruction: Arrange remaining tots on top in a single layer and sprinkle with remaining cheddar. Bake 35–40 minutes until tots are deep golden and center reaches 165°F on a thermometer.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Portion and open the line
steps.instruction: Portion Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole onto sheet trays or hotel pans for family-style service. Stack plates, forks, and napkins at the end of the line so late-arriving crew can self-serve without bottlenecking the cook.

steps.title: Scale for larger halls
steps.instruction: When cooking for more than 8 firefighters, split into two pans halfway through so the bottom layer does not overcook while the top waits — duplicate mise en place if you double batches.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.instruction: Rest 8 minutes so the egg custard sets for clean scoops. Garnish with green onions and serve with ranch or hot sauce at the line. Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a call — never serve picked-over pans to late crew. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Final quality check before service
steps.instruction: Walk the line once before opening service for Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole — confirm hotel pans are labeled, backup trays are in the 200°F oven, and thermometers are calibrated. Rookies should ask a senior cook to spot-check the first portion.

stationWorkflow: Keep tots frozen until they hit the pan—thawed tots turn mushy in the egg layer.
Use a deep pan so the egg mixture does not overflow during baking.
Check center temp with a probe before pulling—golden tots can hide under-set eggs.
cleanupNotes: Line the pan with parchment for easier release and faster cleanup after cheese bakes on.
Wipe bacon grease splatter from the oven door while still warm.
leftovers: Reheat squares on a sheet pan at 375°F for 10 minutes to re-crisp the tot topping.
Crumble leftovers into a breakfast burrito with extra cheese and hot sauce.
